## Context / Problem
Condense 26 allowlisted prose blocks across exactly 18 unit-test paths while retaining current, non-obvious contracts. The audit basis is origin/main@d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84; every scoped blob is byte-identical on current origin/main. Implement in one commit so path checks use HEAD^..HEAD.

## Approach
Edit only ordinary comments/docstrings at the anchors below; executable statements, assertions, runtime strings, directives, and unlisted prose are immutable. For semantic comparison, strip only leading module/class/function docstrings and normalize only ast.TypeIgnore.lineno; compare directives separately.

A non-author reviewer posts one leaf-linked row per edited block:
path<TAB>anchor/kind<TAB>before-citation<TAB>after-citation<TAB>preserved-contract-or-consumer<TAB>before-words<TAB>after-words<TAB>semantic-preservation<TAB>bloat-removal<TAB>reviewer-session
Use full before/final SHAs and PASS in both verdict columns.

## Scope — 26 editable blocks
- tests/unit/test_mcp_plan_review_status.py — module docstring. Preserve the read-only/no-LLM currency query, READ registrar, verdict endpoints, and delegation to the library implementation.
- tests/unit/test_mcp_tool_offload.py — module docstring. Preserve why sync MCP bodies must leave the shared HTTP event loop free and the event-based, non-timing oracle.
- tests/unit/test_measurement_provenance_criterion.py — comment above CONTRACT_DIGESTS. Preserve environment-independent contract-line digests and sentence-only treatment of generated docs.
- tests/unit/test_mechanism_delta.py — module docstring and marker-harvesting section comment above test_a_marker_in_a_new_gate_scripts_head_admits_it. Preserve the shrink-only seven-kind rationale, live census, and why filename-glob/YAML markers require end-to-end harvesting tests.
- tests/unit/test_mirror_lock_terraform.py — module docstring. Preserve human-pushable tags, fail-closed deploy-key precondition, main-lock/bypass rules, and the out-of-band live reconcile boundary.
- tests/unit/test_model_class_ladder.py — module docstring; comment inside test_plan_review_yaml_ladder_carries_no_literal_model_id; test_models_at_or_above_returns_todays_bare_ids_with_no_classes_configured docstring; and provider-escalation section comment above _BEDROCK_PINNED_FRONTIER. Preserve provider-neutral class vocabulary, actual consumer observables, class-only/non-exact ladder assertion, byte-compatible no-class fallback, ordering, and run-provider retention.
- tests/unit/test_module_size_contract.py — module and test_allowlist_mechanism_removed docstrings. Preserve the absolute single-sourced locked limit, wc-compatible count, and prohibition on resurrecting either retired allowlist.
- tests/unit/test_mutation_confirmations.py — shared-seam section comment above seam_spy and verb-inventory section comment above _gen. Preserve exactly-once routing through _confirm, why reducer spying is invalid, no follow-up store read, and single-source generated CLI documentation.
- tests/unit/test_mypy_ratchet.py — module docstring. Preserve shrink-only exemptions/monotonic strict-set semantics and the promotion path.
- tests/unit/test_necessity_criterion.py — module docstring. Preserve deterministic registration/routing/finding/prompt/fixture/recorder coverage and the out-of-band live boundary.
- tests/unit/test_network_fetch_stall_abort_851e.py — module docstring. Preserve the three fetch call sites, shared low-speed seam, wrapper wiring/zero-byte behavior, and ownership of the real libcurl integration.
- tests/unit/test_network_guard_local_ipc.py — module docstring. Preserve the AF_INET/AF_INET6 block, AF_UNIX allowance, and Python 3.14 forkserver motivation.
- tests/unit/test_no_reducer_engine_support_cycle.py — module docstring. Preserve reducer-to-support dependency direction, the function-local alias-resolution exception, and companion AST guard.
- tests/unit/test_no_stale_bare_review_cli.py — module docstring. Preserve the current registered review verbs and intentional exclusions for accurate historical records.
- tests/unit/test_no_verdict_obtainable_2a6f.py — module docstring. Preserve distinction between verifier fault and criterion failure, manifest recovery, verdict_obtainable=False fallback, and fail-closed PASS/FAIL vocabulary.
- tests/unit/test_non_codebase_tag_edge.py — module docstring. Preserve held-out near-miss, findall arity, single-source regex identity, and plan-time parity coverage.
- tests/unit/test_opcert_cross_environment_c21f.py — module docstring. Preserve current cross-environment acceptance of valid certificates, signature enforcement, opt-in environment restriction, and real distinct-principal cases.
- tests/unit/test_opcert_deploy_infra.py — docstrings of test_terraform_opcert_admin_role_ignores_assume_role_policy_drift, test_dockerfile_opcert_uses_ssh_dash_v_for_version_check, and test_opcert_compose_service_is_aws_free. Preserve operator-owned trust-policy drift handling, correct OpenSSH version probe, and file-materialized AWS-free application runtime.

## Consumers and protected directives
Pytest executes all 18 modules. scripts/check_comment_hygiene.py consumes prose; test_mutation_confirmations.py also checks generated CLI-reference inputs. No targeted runtime-documentation consumer was found.

Preserve exact text and attachment of every noqa, type: ignore, pragma, formatter, Ruff, Pyright, and mypy directive in the scoped paths.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Only the 26 allowlisted blocks or adjacent blank lines change.
- [ ] Every edited block is shorter and contains only current, non-obvious rationale or constraints.
- [ ] Every Scope preserve item and consumer contract remains explicit and accurate.
- [ ] Normalized ASTs exactly equal the immutable basis; runtime strings remain AST-identical.
- [ ] All protected directives retain exact text and attachment.
- [ ] HEAD^..HEAD changes exactly the 18 file-impact paths.
- [ ] The non-author TSV has 26 PASS/PASS rows with full before/final SHAs.
- [ ] Every persisted verification command exits 0.

## Verification
Run the complete persisted seven-command contract: normalized AST equality, directive equality, exact one-commit paths, scoped diff check, comment-hygiene guard, focused tests, and make verify.
